subject: Insurance
title: Rideshare Insurance Gaps
description: A quick, practical guide to Rideshare Insurance Gaps.

hook.text: When your Uber driver crashes, whose insurance pays? It depends on app status, ride acceptance, and passenger presence.

buildup.text: Personal auto insurance excludes commercial driving.

discovery.text: Four coverage phases exist: app off (personal policy), app on/waiting (limited Uber coverage), ride accepted.

twist.text: The 'app on but waiting' phase has a dangerous gap. Uber provides only $50,000 liability—far less than the ride itself.

climax.text: Rideshare created a gap that neither personal nor commercial insurance was built for. A new category had to be invented.

punchline.text: App on, off, or ride in progress. Your Uber coverage changes phase by phase.

quiz.question: When does a rideshare driver have the least insurance coverage?
options: When a passenger is in the car
When the app is on but no ride is accepted
